description: Look up an EU VAT number in the European Commission's VIES registry. Returns what the registry says: whether the number exists and, where the member state publishes it, the name and address. It draws NO tax conclusion. VIES is often down; that is reported as disponible=false, which is NOT the same as an invalid number.

numero.description: VAT number, with or without country prefix

pais.description: ISO country code (e.g. DE); omit when the number carries its prefix

name: check_vat_number
title: Check an EU VAT number (VIES)
